title: Harness config
description: Logical schema for the TOML at .harness/config. Defined by format.md §7. This schema describes the TOML once parsed into JSON; it is not a TOML grammar.

format_version.description: Mirrors format.md version. Used to choose migration paths.

auto_snapshot_on_session.description: Whether the SessionStart hook auto-snapshots. See hooks.md.

include_transcripts.description: When true, the hook copies session JSONL into .harness/transcripts/.

mask_paths.description: Glob patterns whose matches are redacted from `source.path` in local-source modules. Matching is repo-relative POSIX globbing.

detect_lockfile.description: Disable APM integration when false. See apm-integration.md.

lockfile_path.description: Repo-relative path to the APM lockfile.

policy.description: Three-level policy for what under .harness/ is committed. See format.md §7.
